text:
anna_docs: Pushed a compact PR to the Optimize toolkit docs addressing three recurring items: quant_profile alias table, a short migration checklist, and two concise SDK snippets (dialog vs batch). Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3620

devbot: PR #3620 opened by anna_docs  labels: docs,optkit,needs-review

carla_writer: skimmed  looks tidy. suggest calling out the exact config fields to change in the checklist so reviewers don't have to hunt.

anna_docs: good idea  added a 3-line checklist up top: 1) add alias mapping to deployment.yaml, 2) run smoke tests, 3) update rollout policy if pinning by profile. also added this sed helper: `sed -i "s/quant_profile:\s*q8_0/q8_0_alias/" **/*.yaml`

jon_eng: quick infra check: runtime unchanged, correct? we don't want surprises.

rachel_opt: runtime unchanged. docs-only. added a compatibility note: "aliases are documented for convenience; no behavioral change in serving unless customers change config."

anna_docs: added two minimal SDK snippets under "Quick snippets". dialog-first:```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_compat')
print(c.generate('User: Hi\nBot:'))
```batch-focused:```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile='q8_compat')
print(c.batch_generate(['Summarize: ...']*32))
```

theo_pm: product nit: step 2 links to Console overview  please point it at /console/telemetry and mention rollouts respect profile aliases. left inline comment.

anna_docs: updated link to /console/telemetry and added a one-line note about rollouts. also added a short "When to disable KV prefetch" paragraph: "Disable for short-turn dialog (seq < 48) to avoid higher first-token p50." pasted tiny microbenchmark lines for reviewers:
```
[smoke] low-latency seq=16 p50=31ms
[smoke] throughput seq=256 p50=118ms
```

devbot: CI: docs-lint PASS, link-check PASS

jon_eng: LGTM from eng side. small inline wording nit about "alias" -> "alias mapping".

carla_writer: LGTM from docs. concise and actionable.

rachel_opt: LGTM from optimization team. will monitor support for any post-merge questions.

anna_docs: merging after CI green. will push a one-line release-note and ping #support to watch for migration questions. :tada:
